messages:
Lucy: Hey team — POC with NovaHealth blocked. They can't provision SCIM users and SAML login fails. Customer sees 403 on SCIM endpoint and SAML login error: 'Invalid ACS URL'. Need an on-call for POC access asap.
Mike: On it. Do we have the IdP metadata they used? Also which env — Hosted API key or Dedicated pool?
Lucy: Dedicated pool. They pasted metadata xml into our console; here's the ACS line they sent: `<AssertionConsumerService Location=\"https://app.redwood-inference.com/saml/consume\" Binding=.../>` but their ACS is actually `https://novahealth.example.com/saml/consume` — looks like a mismatch.
Tara: If their ACS points to novahealth then SP/IdP are swapped. My guess: they uploaded our SP metadata into Okta instead of the IdP metadata. That would also explain why the SAML Audience/EntityID in the assertion doesn't match our SP. For SCIM 403, can you paste the failing request headers from their logs?
Lucy: They pasted a snippet: `POST /scim/v2/Users 403 Authorization: Bearer <redacted> Content-Type: application/json` — they say they rotated the token but still 403. Also our logs show `401 missing x-tenant-id` in some attempts.
Jenna: Security OK to rotate SCIM tokens for POC. We can issue a short-lived token. Also note Dedicated tenants require an `X-Tenant-ID` header that many generic SCIM clients don't send by default. Will note in checklist.
Mike: I'll assemble a quick troubleshooting checklist and a tiny validation script they can run locally. Sending snippet now.
Mike: ```bash
# validate scim token
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $SCIM_TOKEN" \\  -H "X-Tenant-ID: tenant-123" \\  https://api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/tenant-123/scim/v2/Users
# check saml assertion audience / nameid
xmllint --xpath 'string(//Assertion/Subject/NameID)' saml_response.xml
```
Lucy: Customer tried the curl but still 403. Their side shows `401` then `403` in our gateway logs; one log line includes `missing x-tenant-id header` and another shows `invalid scim token`.
Tara: Two parallel things: 1) The SAML ACS mismatch — ask them to re-upload their IdP metadata (Okta/Azure) into our console and ensure our SP metadata is registered in their IdP as a service provider. 2) For SCIM, ensure the client adds `X-Tenant-ID: tenant-123` and `Content-Type: application/scim+json`. Also confirm the SCIM base URL they're hitting: it should be `https://api.redwood-inference.com/dedicated/tenant-123/scim/v2`. If they proxied through some gateway, token header might be stripped.
Lucy: I'm messaging their infra lead now. FYI SAML error shows Audience=`https://api.redwood-inference.com` but Assertion's Audience is `https://novahealth.example.com` — definitely swapped.
Jenna: I've added a short POC security checklist to the security docs channel: scim token rotation steps, X-Tenant-ID requirement for Dedicated, IP allowlist note, and recommended SAML debugging tips (SAML-tracer, check ACS/Audience/NameID format).
Mike: If they can't reconfigure Okta quickly we can spin up a temporary Hosted test tenant to remove the Dedicated header requirement (faster path to unblock POC sign-off).
Lucy: Customer agreed to try Hosted fallback to get sign-off faster. I'll coordinate the temporary tenant and confirm they can sign in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: created ephemeral hosted test tenant `tenant-hosted-xyz` and attached temporary SCIM token (expires in 24h).
